verdict.rationale: Loops documents programmatic access to contacts and mailing lists through the API and its official MCP server, which can "read and write contacts". The API also creates and manages campaigns and workflows, so an agent could pull audience and automation structure. Nothing in the evidence shows the API, CLI or MCP exposing campaign performance results or analytics, which is the core of reporting on what's working. Missing for 10: documented read access to campaign results and metrics, explicit listing of live workflows and their status, and hands-on corroboration of an agent building a program-wide report.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Connect your agent to Loops over MCP. Read and write contacts, events, and content from any client.
The Loops API lets you manage contacts, send events and transactional email, and create and manage campaigns, email content, themes, and workflows.
Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access the rest of the Loops API.
Create and update workflow graphs, change mailing lists, and add, branch, edit, or delete nodes from code.
